tickets.request: Internet not working since morning. The light on the box is blinking red. TV also not working.
tickets.summary: Dad: internet and TV down since morning, router light red
tickets.steps:
1. Find the internet box with the red light. Pull its power plug out of the wall.
2. Wait 1 minute. Then plug it back in.
3. Wait 5 minutes. Do not touch anything while the lights come back.
4. Check that all cables on the box are pushed in firmly, especially the thin cable from the wall.
5. If the light is still red, the problem may be with the internet company. Send me a photo of the box and the lights, and I will check it with them.
6. The TV uses the internet too, so it should start working once the internet is back.

tickets.request: Got this SMS: 'Dear customer, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your last month bill was not updated. Please contact our officer immediately at 98XXXXXX10.' Should I call?
tickets.summary: Mom got SMS threatening electricity disconnection tonight, asks to call
tickets.warning: This looks like a scam. Do not call the number in the message. Do not click any links. Do not share any codes, OTPs, PINs, passwords, or bank or card details with anyone. Do not install any app they ask for. Check with me first before doing anything.
tickets.steps:
1. Do not call the number in the SMS.
2. Do not reply to the message.
3. Do not pay anything or install any app if someone calls you.
4. If you are worried about the bill, look at your last paper bill or the official electricity company app. Call only the number printed there.
5. Delete the SMS and block the sender.
6. Call me if they contact you again.

tickets.request: WhatsApp is saying storage full. I cannot download the photos you sent.
tickets.summary: Mother-in-law's phone storage full, can't download WhatsApp photos
tickets.steps:
1. Open WhatsApp. Tap the three dots (Android) or Settings (iPhone). Then tap Settings, then Storage and data, then Manage storage.
2. Tap 'Larger than 5 MB' or 'Forwarded many times'. These are usually big videos and forwarded clips.
3. Tick the items you do not need. Tap the bin icon to delete them. Only delete things you are sure you don't want.
4. Open your Gallery or Photos app. Delete old videos you no longer need. They take the most space.
5. Turn the phone off and on again.
6. Open my chat and tap the photos to download them again. If it still says full, message me and I will help.

tickets.request: Someone called from the bank saying my card is blocked. He said he will send an OTP and I should read it to him to unblock the card. He was very polite.
tickets.summary: Caller claiming bank asked Father-in-law to read OTP
tickets.warning: This looks like a scam. Real banks never ask you to read out an OTP, even if the caller is very polite. Do not tell anyone the OTP or any code, PIN, or password. Do not click any links in messages. Do not call any number the caller or the message gave you. If he calls again, just hang up. Please check with me first before doing anything.
tickets.steps:
1. Do not read the OTP to anyone. Not to the caller, not to anyone else.
2. If he calls again, hang up. You do not need to be polite.
3. If you already shared a code, call your bank right away. Use the number on the back of your card.
4. If you did not share anything, you can still call that number on your card to check your card.
5. Delete any message with the OTP after you have hung up.
6. Call or message me so we can check together.

tickets.request: Phone is saying storage almost full again. Same as last month.
tickets.summary: Mom's phone storage almost full again, recurring monthly
tickets.steps:
1. Open WhatsApp. Tap the three dots or Settings, then Storage and data, then Manage storage. Delete big videos and forwarded files you don't need.
2. Open your Photos app. Delete blurry photos, duplicates, and old screenshots. Then empty the 'Recently deleted' or 'Bin' folder.
3. Open Settings, then Storage. Look at which apps take the most space.
4. Delete apps you never use. Tap and hold the app icon, then tap Uninstall or Remove App.
5. In WhatsApp Settings, tap Storage and data. Turn off auto-download for photos and videos so the phone doesn't fill up again.
6. If it is still full, send me a screenshot of the Storage screen and I will help.

tickets.request: How do we video call you on the new smart TV? The grandkids want to see us on the big screen.
tickets.summary: Dad wants to video call family on new smart TV
tickets.steps:
1. Send me a photo of the TV's brand and model. It is on a sticker on the back of the TV. Most smart TVs need a separate camera for video calls, so this tells me what yours needs.
2. The easiest way for now: start the video call on your phone as usual (for example on WhatsApp).
3. On your phone, look for 'Screen Mirroring', 'Cast', or 'Smart View' in the quick settings. Pick your TV from the list.
4. Your call now shows on the big screen. Prop the phone up facing you so the grandkids can see you.
5. If the sound is quiet, turn up the volume on the TV remote.
6. If we add a TV camera later, only install apps from the TV's own app store. Call me first and I will walk you through it.
